case.summary: A $292.36 online purchase on card C11891-K1 was flagged by a real-time model with a score of 0.79. The evidence is mixed: the amount is far above the card’s typical spend but the model treats the score as a weak input, and one finding points to fraud while another points neither way. The case remains open because the bank asked the customer to validate the transaction and received no reply within 24 hours. The fraud probability is 0.37, so the decision was to decline the pending authorization, keep the card under monitoring, and keep the case open pending further customer response.
